description:
PROBLEM: six slow medium tests repeat checks that another test or a blocking gate already makes (about 75 s of PR CI time, local estimates).

CHANGES (each is a separate decision; apply only those whose gate passes):
D1 Delete tests/unit/benchmarks/test_read_primitives_pyspark_execution.py::TestPySparkSkipList::test_non_skipped_queries_do_not_use_unsupported_apis (18.3 s CI). Claimed cover: the parametrized TestAllRunnableQueriesExecute::test_expression_impl_executes family runs every query and fails on any exception.
D2 Delete tests/integration/test_tpcdi_phase3_benchmark.py::TestTPCDIPhase3PerformanceIntegration::test_quality_monitoring_performance (9.4 s). Its only timing assertion is quality_duration >= 0; the quality check is mocked; claimed cover: test_data_quality_monitoring_phase in the same module.
D3 Delete the tuning-legacy case of tests/integration/test_execution_engine_sources.py::test_cli_agreeing_sources_resolve_to_the_highest_precedence (15.2 s). Claimed cover: tests/integration/test_deprecation_warnings_visible.py::test_polars_streaming_flag_warns_once_and_records_legacy_option runs the same argv with the same receipt assertions.
D4 Delete tests/integration/test_ssb_cross_surface_equivalence.py::test_ssb_previously_empty_queries_now_discriminate (10.8 s); move its constant assertion (the known-empty list is empty) into the SSB SQL reference row-count test in the same file. Claimed cover: exact non-zero row counts at SF 0.1 (ssb_results.py) and the correctness-gate zero-row check.
D5 Delete tests/unit/scripts/test_check_windows_antipatterns.py::test_repository_baseline_is_current (11.9 s). Claimed cover: make windows-antipatterns-check in the blocking code-lint guard (ci.yml) that the required core check depends on; unit tests in the same file keep covering check_file/check_tree/apply_baseline.
D6 Fold tests/integration/test_dataframe_adapter_smoke.py::TestCrossPlatformConsistency::test_group_by_produces_same_row_count and ::test_join_produces_same_row_count into the per-engine smoke tests' absolute counts, adding the one missing case (filter > 1500 returns 3 rows) to each engine's smoke test, then delete the two cross-platform tests.

DECISION GATES (per deletion):
G1 Show, with file:line, that the claimed covering test or gate exists on origin/develop and asserts a superset of the deleted test's assertions. If not a superset, do not delete; record why.
G2 C1 coverage: lines executed by the deleted test minus lines executed by its cover must be empty (or listed and justified). For D5 the cover is a lint job, so compare against the remaining unit tests in that file plus the lint command run via subprocess and state the result.
G3 C2 mutation: break the property (for example raise an unsupported-API exception in one query impl for D1; make a previously-empty SSB query return no rows for D4; inject a stale baseline entry for D5 and confirm make windows-antipatterns-check fails) and show the cover fails.
G4 For D5 confirm the lint guard runs whenever the medium tier runs (ci.yml conditions); if not, keep the test.

D7 (evaluate only): tests/integration/test_tpcdi_phase3_benchmark.py::TestTPCDIPhase3PerformanceIntegration::test_incremental_loading_performance asserts a wall-time bound (< 30 s). Gate: search CI junit of the last 20 medium runs available to you for failures of this id; if it never failed and its p95 is under 10 s, record that and leave it; otherwise replace the timing bound with a structural assertion of what the incremental load must do, with a C2 mutation.
